I-001.threat: Eavesdropping on embedded bus {{dataFlowName}} between {{sourceName}} and {{targetName}}
I-001.cause: Embedded bus communication is unencrypted and physically accessible — data can be passively captured
I-001.attack: Attacker attaches a logic analyzer to the embedded bus and captures all traffic

I-002.threat: Sensitive data extraction via {{dataFlowName}} interface from {{targetName}}
I-002.cause: Debug interface is accessible without readback protection — firmware and cryptographic keys are readable
I-002.attack: Attacker connects to the {{dataFlowName}} interface and reads flash memory to extract firmware, API keys, or cryptographic material

I-003.threat: Shared-memory readout via {{dataFlowName}} — secrets or residual data exposed when {{targetName}} reads the region
I-003.cause: The shared-memory region read over {{dataFlowName}} lacks access control or is not cleared after use
I-003.attack: An attacker with access to the region (low-privilege task, peripheral, or debug) reads keys, sensor data, or residual buffer contents
